name: find_recent_transaction
purpose: The household's most recent transactions, newest first, for resolving what "it" or "the last one" refers to. From v_transaction_detail only. Reclassification reaches any member's transaction (R15a); a financial correction to someone else's is refused at the database, not here.

mine_only.description: True to restrict to the acting member's own captures, for "my last one".

unconfirmed_only.description: True when the question is about what is still waiting for review.
